description: Measured differences between the native engine and Chromium 156.0.8078.4 for tests/fixtures/caret-hit-oracle.json. tests/abi/caret_hit.py requires exactly these; any other difference fails.

qualifications.name: legacy-range-shadow-retarget
qualifications.reason: Document.caretRangeFromPoint (non-standard; CSSOM View defines only caretPositionFromPoint) retargets a hit inside a shadow tree or text control to the host element at offset 0 (WebKit Document::caretPositionFromPoint(LayoutPoint) retargetToScope). Chromium returns the host's parent at the host's index, as caretPositionFromPoint does in both engines.

qualifications.name: collapsed-line-end-rect
qualifications.reason: CaretPosition.getClientRect at a line end before a collapsed trailing space (wrap offsets 4 and 9, RTL offset 4): WebKit Range::boundingClientRect of the collapsed range gives 0x0 at (0, 0); Chromium gives the 0x20 caret box at the line end. Node and offset agree.

qualifications.name: text-control-rect
qualifications.reason: CaretPosition.getClientRect for a position in a text control (offsetNode INPUT, offset 1): WebKit measures the collapsed range (INPUT, 1), which has no layout box, and gives 0x0 at (0, 0); Chromium gives the 0x20 caret box inside the control.

qualifications.name: stale-offset-rect
qualifications.reason: A held CaretPosition whose text node was shortened below its offset (offset 7, data "AA"): WebKit clamps the offset and gives the 0x20 caret box at the text end (x 40); Chromium gives 0x0 at (0, 0).
